title: Thinking Kaomoji (´-ω-`)ｳｰﾝ: Copy & Paste Hmm Text Faces
meta_description: Copy and paste thinking kaomoji: hmm faces (´-ω-`)ｳｰﾝ, pondering (˘･_･˘), thought bubbles ( ˘ω˘ )。o○, note-taking φ(．．) and idea faces ☝(ﾟヮﾟ).
hero_tagline: Pondering, hmm-ing, taking notes and landing on an idea. Tap any thinking face to copy it.
intro: A thinking kaomoji usually has closed or half-closed eyes, a flat mouth and something trailing after it. Japanese writers add the sound of thought: ｳｰﾝ (uun) and ﾝｰ (nn) are the drawn-out hmm, and ｳｰﾑ (uumu) is a heavier, more serious one. Small circles like 。o○ rise from the face as a thought bubble. φ is the Greek letter phi, and next to a face it looks like a pen, so φ(．．) is someone writing notes. A raised finger ☝ marks the moment the idea arrives. Use these while weighing a decision, mulling a reply or teasing that you are planning something. The 🤔 emoji is on the thinking emoji page linked below.

faq.q: What does ｳｰﾝ mean after a kaomoji?
faq.a: ｳｰﾝ (uun) is the Japanese sound of someone thinking hard or hesitating, close to a long English hmm. It is written in half-width katakana so it sits snugly next to the face.

faq.q: What is the φ in φ(．．)?
faq.a: φ is the Greek letter phi. Its upright stroke and loop look like a pen held in the hand, so a face beside it reads as someone writing notes.

faq.q: Is there a kaomoji for the 🤔 emoji?
faq.a: There is no single standard one. (´-ω-`)ｳｰﾝ and (˘･_･˘) carry the same meaning, and adding a raised finger ☝ gets closer to the hand-on-chin pose of 🤔.
